# GEMS2 – Copilot Field Manual
- **Stack & runtime.** PHP monolith under `htdocs/gems2`; serve via Apache/XAMPP at `http://localhost/gems2/*.html`. Run `composer install` for PhpSpreadsheet/TCPDF deps, sync schema with `/maintenance` SQL bundles, and deploy using `./deploy_production.sh` or rsync while excluding `developer/`.
- **Two backend stacks.** Core APIs (`api/*.php`) rely on `General::getUrlArr`, `DbMysql`, and traits such as `api/trait/SiteFilterTrait.php`. PTW endpoints (`api/ptw*.php`, `api/function/f_ptw.php`) use `Class_*` helpers plus `Class_login::check_jwt`; dev JWTs are whitelisted for local testing.
- **Response contract.** Every API returns `{ success, result, error, errmsg }`. Wrap writes with `DbMysql::beginTransaction()`/`commit()` and rollback on exceptions before calling `General::outputResult`. Enable verbose traces via `Constant::$isLogged = true` when debugging.
- **Auth & site scope.** JWT is mandatory unless the path starts with `/ext`. Roles `1,10` bypass site filters; other roles must hit `/site/{siteId}` variants, with server-side enforcement handled by `SiteFilterTrait` (details in `SITE_FILTERING_IMPLEMENTATION.md`).
- **Frontend pairing.** Each HTML page binds to a twin script in `js/pages/` that talks to APIs through `mzAjaxRequest`. Shared helpers live in `js/common.js` (`mzGetUserInfoByParam`, `mzIsRoleExist`, `mzOption`). Non-admin dropdowns stay locked to the user’s site and always call the scoped endpoints.
- **Modern UI blueprint.** New admin pages reuse the `license.html` pattern: gradient header (`.license-page-header`), metrics row (`.metric-card`), filter card with custom search (`txt<Module>Search`, `opt<Module>Status`), then a DataTable inside `.license-data-card`. Hide DataTables’ default filter, set mobile labels via `fnRowCallback`, and refresh `lbl<Module>Count`/`lbl<Module>Updated` after each draw.
- **Work Order flow (`api/wo_v3.php`).** `POST /api/wo_v3.php` accepts `{ siteId, complaint, image? }`, generates WO numbers (`WoTask::generateNo`), queues notifications (`Email::prepare`, `Noti::prepare`, `NotiWeb::insert`), and records audits with `WoTask::saveAudit`. Lists live under `/pending_assign`, `/submitted_assign`, `/pending_verify`, `/submitted_verify` plus `/site/{id}` variants. Actions like `submit_assign`, `reassign`, and `reject_complaint` always run inside a transaction and append audit + notification entries.
- **Permit-to-Work (`api/ptw.php`, `api/ptw_approve.php`).** Workflow: `DRAFT → PENDING_SUPERVISOR → PENDING_SHE → PENDING_FM → ACTIVE → EXTENDED/CLOSED`. Request numbers `RQPTW{site}{yymmdd}{seq}` generate at submit; permit numbers `PTW...` appear on supervisor approval. Public submissions from `ptw_form.html` must set `public_user=Public User` and `site_id`. Supervisor/SHE/FM actions arrive as `POST action=...` payloads and may trigger PDFs via `api/ptw_pdf.php`.
- **Asset + reference masters.** `api/asset.php` mirrors PTW helpers, enforces JWT/site rules, and logs audits `56-62`. Reference endpoints (`asset_group.php`, `asset_category.php`, etc.) expose GET/POST/PUT/DELETE with activation toggles instead of hard deletes. Frontend modules in `js/pages/main_asset*.js` reuse the same role/site gating pattern as Work Orders.
- **Imports & templates.** `wo_import.html`/`api/wo_import.php` and `ppm_import.html`/`api/ppm_import.php` share a four-step wizard (select → upload → validate → import) plus downloadable customer templates. Excel generation leans on PhpSpreadsheet (see `api/class/Zone.php::downloadTemplate`), while PDFs use TCPDF under `api/pdf/`.
- **Notifications trio.** `api/class/Email.php`, `api/class/Noti.php`, and `api/class/NotiWeb.php` validate every placeholder before inserting rows into `email_send`, `noti_send`, and `noti_web`. Missing params throw immediately—mirror the call shapes inside `api/wo_v3.php` when introducing new templates or message IDs.
- **Debugging toolkit.** Use `debug_*.php`, `check_*.php`, and the `developer/` folder for diagnostics, sample data, and API smoke tests (`test_api.html`, `test_ppm_import_20_tasks.csv`, etc.). Run these scripts through the browser and keep the entire `developer/` tree out of production builds.
- **Key references.** Backend: `api/class/General.php`, `api/class/DbMysql.php`, `api/class/WoTask.php`, `api/class/Email.php`, `api/class/Noti.php`, `api/class/NotiWeb.php`. Frontend: `js/common.js`, `js/pages/main_wo_assign.js`, `js/pages/main_license.js`. Ops: `deploy_production.sh`, `maintenance/README.md`, `SITE_FILTERING_IMPLEMENTATION.md`.
